porntrex.reinstalls: signed in after 5 of 7 reinstalls; twice, during a stretch of about a dozen test logins, Porntrex deleted kt_member after a reinstall (the same token had been accepted minutes earlier). Not reproduced on demand; cause unconfirmed. Ptrex then opens /login/; at worst this matches the accepted monthly login.

rootCauses: XVideos' login cookie is session-only and version 1; Foundation ignores Expires on version-1 cookies, so the extended copy is stored as version 0.
WKHTTPCookieStore change notifications did not fire for response cookies; the keeper also runs every 3 seconds and at resign/background.
WebKit wrote cookies to disk only on suspension; a foreground kill lost a fresh login until the app kept its own copy of the login cookies and restored missing ones before the first load.
A removed login (logout or local sign-out) clears that copy, so it is never resurrected.

notes: The online apps store the sites' login cookies (session tokens, not passwords) in their own container, beside WebKit's cookie file.
The monthly renewal reinstalls the apps; Xvid kept its login through every reinstall.
Physical finger feel (swipes, momentum, pull-down reload, landscape) remains for the user to compare with Safari.
